title: 第766章 一鞭一碗第765章 丐帮内乱
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
江尘继续开口道：“行走江湖，武艺是不能缺的，丐帮内也一直设有传武堂。
你们堂口有年轻力壮、聪明伶俐的，也可以送过来学武，否则只是一群乞丐，怎么能站得住地盘？”
“至于鲁方三做得不错，我准备让他当长老，统管平棘县丐帮事务，你觉得怎么样？”
“当长老？比副帮主大吗？”
“长老不满意，可以换了副帮主。”
鲁七猛一瞪眼：“那俺爹肯定愿意！”
“那就好。”江尘点点头，“郡城的事，你们也不必打来打去的，都是丐帮兄弟，不能伤了和气。
索性就设置两个堂口，一个负责城内，一个负责城外，双方有什么事合作着来，不要冲突，怎么样？”
“帮主！”包宪成本想着让江尘给自己站台，却没想到最后让鲁七占尽了便宜，不满地开口辩驳。
鲁七握着手中的拳谱，他根本就不识字，却仍旧目光灼灼。
此时生怕江尘反悔一样，立马应了：“俺们愿意！”
“我手上有一批粮食，要在郡城里卖出去。
你们找找路子，在城里面找一个地方开个粮店，以后在城内卖粮的事情也交给你们。”
这时鲁七的眼睛已经红了，他自然知道，如今卖粮的生意，利润有多大。
可以说，谁有粮谁就是老大。
若是和朔县能将粮食交给他们卖，他们从中间不知能赚多少钱。
“多谢帮主！”
江尘一招手，身旁的仆役将那木盒端了起来，在鲁七面前打开。
里面是一个纯银海碗，只不过旁边破了一角。
看那破口，应该是被人用蛮力硬生生掰下来的，让鲁七一阵咋舌。

江尘道：“鲁方三能在郡城内把丐帮堂口立起来，有功无过。这只银碗是我让人打造的，算是奖赏。
日后你们有什么难处，拿着这只银碗过来找我，我能做到的一定做。”
鲁七再也绷不住，扑通一下跪倒在地：“谢帮主！”
“起来吧。你们既然是丐帮的，就要遵守丐帮的规矩，帮内皆兄弟，再有互相动手的，按帮规论处。”
“是！”
鲁七小心翼翼地捧着那个银碗，一路离开了来福客栈。
反倒是包宪成紧绷着一张脸，看着江尘说道：“帮主，你太过纵容他们了，他们之后也未必会听你的。”
江尘斜眼看向他：“那你说怎么办？将鲁七在这打杀了？之后鲁方三自立门户，你们俩在城里做过一场。”
“就是做过一场又怎么样？我开春之前就能够把他们全部收拾了！”
“包宪成！”江尘声音一冷。
包宪成抬头，对上江尘一双森然墨瞳，竟然感觉脖子有些发凉。
扑通一声跪倒：“尘哥，我……说说而已。”
“当初你我一起立下的帮规第二条是什么？”
content_en:
Jiang Chen continued to speak: "Walking skills are indispensable when traveling in the world, and the Beggar Clan has always had a martial arts hall.
If you have young, strong, and smart people in your hall, you can send them over to learn martial arts. Otherwise, they are just a bunch of beggars, how can they maintain their territory? "
"As for Lu Fangsan doing a good job, I plan to make him an elder and take charge of the affairs of the Beggar Clan in Pingji County. What do you think?"
"Being an elder? Is he bigger than the deputy gang leader?"
"If the elder is not satisfied, you can change the deputy leader."
Lu Qi glared: "Then my father will definitely be willing!"
"That's good." Jiang Chen nodded, "You don't have to fight back and forth about the county and city matters. We are all brothers of the beggar gang, so we can't hurt the harmony.
How about simply setting up two gates, one responsible for the inside of the city and one for the outside of the city. If the two sides have anything to do, they can cooperate without conflict. "
"Gang leader!" Bao Xianchen thought of asking Jiang Chen to stand up for him, but he didn't expect that Lu Qi would take advantage in the end, so he argued dissatisfiedly.
Lu Qi held the boxing manual in his hand. He could not read at all, but his eyes were still bright.
At this time, he was afraid that Jiang Chen would regret it, so he immediately agreed: "We are willing!"
"I have a batch of grain in hand that I want to sell in the county.
You guys find a way to find a place to open a grain store in the city. From now on, I will leave the matter of selling grain in the city to you. "
Lu Qi's eyes were already red at this time. He naturally knew how profitable the business of selling grain was now.
It can be said that whoever has the food is the boss.
If Heshuo County can give them food to sell, they don't know how much money they can make from it.
"Thank you, leader!"
Jiang Chen waved, and the servant beside him picked up the wooden box and opened it in front of Lu Qi.
Inside is a sterling silver sea bowl, but one corner is broken on the side.
Looking at the gap, it seemed that someone had torn it off with brute force, which made Lu Qi speechless for a while.
Jiang Chen said: "Lu Fangsan was able to establish the Beggar Clan Hall in the county town, and he has done everything he can to make it happen. This silver bowl was made by me, and it can be regarded as a reward."
If you have any difficulties in the future, come to me with this silver bowl, and I will do whatever I can. "
Lu Qi could no longer hold back and fell to his knees: "Thank you, Gang Leader!"
"Get up. Since you are from the Beggar Clan, you must abide by the rules of the Beggar Clan. We are all brothers in the Clan. Anyone who attacks each other will be punished according to the Clan rules."
"Yes!"
Lu Qi carefully held the silver bowl and left the Laifu Inn.
On the contrary, Bao Xiancheng looked at Jiang Chen with a tense face and said, "Gang leader, you are too indulgent to them, and they may not listen to you in the future."
Jiang Chen looked at him sideways: "Then what do you think we should do? Kill Lu Qi here? After that, Lu Fangsan set up his own business, and you two had a show in the city."
"So what if I just did it once? I can take care of them all before spring starts!"
"Bao Xiancheng!" Jiang Chen's voice turned cold.
Bao Xiancheng raised his head and faced Jiang Chen's pair of dark eyes, and felt a chill on his neck.
He knelt down with a plop: "Brother Chen, I... was just talking."
"What is the second gang rule that you and I established together?"
